title.zh: Saturation 压力的水 水汽：5 或 7 m³/h 的液压喷涂机不是拖泵订单保留「两张液压页都印 380 V。」

description.en: Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine at /products/hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine. Both hydraulic pages print 380 V Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h as a trailer pump
description.zh: 5 或 7 m³/h 的液压喷涂机不是拖泵订单见 /products/hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine。两张液压页都印 380 V。选型说明里这些行的粒径是 ≤8 mm。

h1.en: Density of Water Vapor is the heading; Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「密度的水 水汽」，主体仍是5 或 7 m³/h 的液压喷涂机不是拖泵订单

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine. The row to open is /products/hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine. Both hydraulic pages print 380 V. Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h as a trailer pump. Particle size on the selection note for these rows is ≤8 mm. The high-flow machine prints 380 V, 11/15 kW, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa and 150 m / 70 m. The 5 m³/h path is the hydraulic concrete spraying machine without the high-flow name. It still does not become the voltage of Electric 40, which does not print a voltage cell. The 5 m³/h machine prints 380 V, 7.5/9 kW dual motors, 8 MPa, 100 m / 50 m and hose 38/51 mm. The diesel concrete sprayer also prints 5 m³/h, but on 28/32 HP with particle ≤6 mm and 80 m / 40 m. Name the path, ≤8 mm or your particle size, and that the site can or cannot supply the printed motors. A buyer who needs 5 m³/h of concrete through a trailer should open a trailer page instead, because these sheets are sprayers and are quote-only. The section title “Saturation Pressure of Water Vapor” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints a 380 V hydraulic sprayer at 5 m³/h and a high-flow hydraulic sprayer at 7 m³/h. Both list particle ≤8 mm. They are not Electric 15 or Diesel 30.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是5 或 7 m³/h 的液压喷涂机不是拖泵订单的数字。要打开的行是 /products/hydraulic-concrete-spraying-machine。两张液压页都印 380 V。选型说明里这些行的粒径是 ≤8 mm。电动15作为拖泵印的是 8–10 m³/h。它仍然不会变成电动40的电压，电动40没有印电压格。5 m³/h 的路径是不带大流量名称的液压混凝土喷涂机。写明路径、≤8 mm 或你的粒径，以及现场能否供给所印电机。如果要的是拖泵输送 5 m³/h 混凝土，应打开拖泵页，因为这两张表是喷涂机，并且只询价。大流量那台印 380 V、11/15 kW、7 m³/h、8 MPa、150 m / 70 m。柴油混凝土喷涂机也印 5 m³/h，但是 28/32 HP、粒径 ≤6 mm、80 m / 40 m。5 m³/h 那台印 380 V、双电机 7.5/9 kW、8 MPa、100 m / 50 m、软管 38/51 mm。节标题「Saturation 压力的水 水汽」来自来源页，不另加额定值。 河北品锦机械在邢台印有 380 V 液压喷涂机 5 m³/h，以及大流量液压喷涂机 7 m³/h。两者都写粒径 ≤8 mm。它们不是电动15或柴油30。

question.en: Does “Saturation Pressure of Water Vapor” replace Both hydraulic pages print 380 V?
question.zh: 「Saturation 压力的水 水汽」会替换「两张液压页都印 380 V。」吗？

answer.en: No. Both hydraulic pages print 380 V remains the printed wording for Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine.
answer.zh: 不会。两张液压页都印 380 V。仍是5 或 7 m³/h 的液压喷涂机不是拖泵订单已印的说法。
